name: Litlyx
line: Tracks website pageviews and custom events with pooled usage limits.

free.text: Free self-hosted core; cloud free-plan status is disputed

pv.math: 10,000 pageviews count as 10,000 units. The Standard plan costs €6.99 a month.
100,000 pageviews count as 100,000 units. The Standard plan costs €14.99 a month.
1,000,000 pageviews count as 1,000,000 units. The Standard plan costs €48.99 a month.
